== Objectives ==
Bring the wooden toy sword to someone that knew its owner. You may have luck in Northwind, where all of this started.
* [[Etched Toy Sword]]

== Description ==
<Among the puddle left behind by the monstrosity, you find a badly damaged wooden sword. Its size is tiny and the ooze's acid etched most of its surface. You can, however, decipher the words “Sir Tim-” on the toy's hilt. Perhaps that is enough to know who it belonged to.>

==Rewards==
You will receive:
* 1200 XP

== Progress ==
<Judith is still sobbing.>

Oh, Sara, my darling angel… By the Light, please let my Timothy be safe…!

== Completion ==
What…? What is this? Where did you…?! No, no, no! Timothy! My little Timmy, no! Oh, Light, why have you forsaken me?! He was just a boy, my sweet, innocent boy!

<Judith is breaking down. Hysteric crying and yelling is all she can do right now. You did what you could. Atleast she has certainty now.>
